lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural (form VI) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَتَغَامَزُونَ is in the derivative form: يَتَغامَز
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
غ/م/ز gh–m–z nudge, wink; squeeze; dimple; to examine, to probe an animal for defects, weakness, faults. Of this root, onlyيَتَغامَزون yataghāmazūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَتَغامَز yataghāmaz [imperf. of v. VI, intrans.] to wink at one another, to nudge one another

(83:30) وَإِذَا‏ ‏مَرُّوا‏ ‏بِهِمْ‏ ‏يَتَغَامَزُونَ‏and when they pass by them they nudge one another.
